notes.title: Patch v1.03 this is a big one
notes.notes:
We finally have saves of high score and highest rounds I am sorry it took a bit long but was doing some balancing to the monsters and the weapons people were telling me about and we got a toggle shoot button so the primary weapon can shoot without clicking the mouse \^w^/ hope you like the work so far and tell me what you think.

detailed breakdown of patch:
-The first monsters now have dynamic health to make first levels easier for players.
-Weapons that used mana have had an upgrade on damage (the some tweaks on mana usage... just a bit).
-A message now pops up when enemies are becoming stronger (getting more health).
-Saving, now high score and highest round are been kept stored on your computer.
-Saving settings, now if you clicked toggle shoot, or full screen the game will remember.
-Toggle shoot is now a reality so people that have disabilities and or don't want to hold the button can do so for the main weapon although other weapons will need be held since they consume mana.
